answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Ridge Rule. Each identity accumulates a per-epoch behavioural vector (action mix, counterparty spread, response latencies); the system computes a ridge regression predicting epoch t+1 behaviour from epochs t-k..t. A cheap beacon score flags identities whose new epoch deviates beyond the fitted tolerance band. Persistence requires the residual to stay low across consecutive epochs, forming a trellis of consistent transitions an attacker cannot fake without sustained history.
